Marissa / Olivia,

Quick technical check-in: for an EU isolated VPC with two additional clusters, recommended configuration is: 4x A100-80GB equiv nodes per cluster (mixed q4/mixed-int8 quantized profile), NVMe staging, and single-node warm-standby per cluster for failover. Provisioning ETA from order to green is ~21 business days for a private cluster in the EU region (we reserve the slot once PO is received).

Notes for procurement: we can stage one cluster first (EU1) and gate second cluster on monitoring metrics at the 30-day mark to reduce immediate lift. This approach also lets us defer 50% of the hardware charge for cluster 2 until the gate is met. If ApexCare signs a 24-month term, we can apply the multi-site 12% discount across both clusters.

Marcus
